name: Admin Accounting History
description: Superuser audits the accounting module at /panel/accounting/history through two subtabs, both server-paginated 20 per page. 'Cambios': change log (GET /api/accounting/change-logs/) with entity/action/actor/record/date filters and expandable field-level old→new diffs per entry. 'Envíos': send log (GET /api/accounting/email-log/) showing which recipients each automated email of the module actually reached — one row per address — with aviso/estado/destinatario/date filters plus the record, client, project and subject cuts. Both subtabs carry a predefined tab strip, own saved tabs and URL-persisted filters (admin-accounting-history-filters), and a send row can be read and retried (admin-accounting-history-diagnosis). Exporting either subtab as CSV/XLSX goes through the same filters as the list (admin-accounting-export). Envíos incluye “Ingreso completo — cuenta pendiente”: aviso interno creado al completar por primera vez un esperado de empresa sin cuenta emitida, con ingreso objetivo y estado real de entrega.
